title: MacBrains Labs ANE Research Records
description:
Versioned, source-bound public research records from MacBrains Labs. Each version is a cumulative snapshot of the archive repository; v0.1.0 holds the original public measurement summaries, v0.2.0 the LFM3-1.7B layer-14 diagnostic record and v0.3.0 the ANERECore MIL parity record. Version v0.4.0 adds the diagnostic record Published Qwen2.5-1.5B Core ML package: greedy output depends on the compute unit, and cpuOnly returns NaN in records/ane-record-10528818ee0e902331b666ee/.

Scope: same-chip, single device (Mac17,5, macOS 27.3 26C5035r, Core ML 3610.2.3); Hugging Face package NayteThaGreat/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-ANE at 7f9ab466, one prompt, greedy; ANE and GPU differ from the first token, cpuOnly prefill all NaN; no reference output; ANE execution inferred; no novelty claim. Same-chip reruns are repeatability only, not cross-device replication. Three Core ML compute-unit settings under two setup profiles, each committed before its first counted run: 15 runs logged device-wide, all counted, all passed, all disclosed. The record reports a behavior of a model package that MacBrains Labs itself published on Hugging Face; no reference output was run.

Records are reviewed summaries, not peer-reviewed results. The reported measurements have not been independently replicated by this deposit. Reviewed package SHA-256 10528818ee0e902331b666eeab96c42217b8bfbe71ce870b61dba9125986e780; reviewed record SHA-256 363f37782e0fa515319f6cdc7c1cd490a65e912d1a9411c46e7455c3428361a8.
